Physicists are biased towards seeking “beautiful,” symmetrical, and compact equations to describe the complex interactions that make up our reality. But I am wondering, given this drive towards “beauty,” what will happen to physics if the laws of nature turn out to be fundamentally “ugly” and complicated?
